research_evidence: عمر بْن عَبْد الرَّحْمَنِ أَبُو حَفْص الْأَبَّار الْقرشِي من أهل الْكُوفَة يروي عَنِ الْأَعْمَش وَابْن أبي خَالِد
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن عبيد الله بن أبي رافع
bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says he was a mawla of Sa'id ibn al-'As from Medina, narrating from Muhriz ibn Abi Hurayra, with Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Abi Kathir narrating from him. Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) notes he is also said to be a mawla of Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas and that he saw Abu Hurayra, Abu Qatada, Ibn 'Umar and Abu Usayd.
research_students: Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Abi Kathir
research_evidence: عُثْمَان بْن عبيد اللَّه بْن أبي رَافع مولى سعيد بن الْعَاصِ من أهل الْمَدِينَة يروي عَنْ مُحرز بْن أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن عبيد الله بن رافع
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) says 'Uthman ibn 'Ubaydullah ibn Rafi' narrated from Ibn 'Umar and Hisham ibn Sa'd narrated from him. Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) describes him as a mawla of the Prophet who narrated from his father.
research_evidence: عُثْمَان بْن عبيد اللَّه بْن رَافع مولى النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يروي عَن أَبِيه
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says he was the brother of Malik ibn Dinar, narrated from him, and his daughter Hakkama bint 'Uthman narrated from him. Ibn al-Jawzi (al-Du'afa' wa al-Matrukun) quotes al-'Uqayli that Hakkama narrated baseless, false hadiths from him.
research_evidence: عُثْمَان بْن دِينَار أَخُو مَالك بْن دِينَار يروي عَنْ مَالك بْن دِينَار رَوَت عَنْهُ ابْنَته حَكَّامَة بنت عُثْمَان بْن دِينَار
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن عبيد الله أبو المنازل
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) identify Abu al-Manazil as the maternal nephew of the judge Shurayh; he narrated from Shurayh, and al-Shaybani and Hajjaj narrated from him. Al-Bukhari and Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) state he served as judge of Khurasan.
research_evidence: عثمان بن عبيد الله أبو المنازل وهو ابن اخى شريح لامه روى عن شريح روى عنه الشيباني وحجاج
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن محمد بن عبيد الله
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) and Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) identify him as 'Uthman ibn Muhammad ibn 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar ibn al-Khattab al-Qurashi of Medina, Abu Qudama. He heard from 'A'isha bint Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, and Khalid ibn Makhlad al-Qatawani narrated from him.
research_evidence: عُثْمَان بْن مُحَمَّد بْن عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْن عمر بْن الْخطاب من أهل الْمَدِينة
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن عبد الله بن الأرقم
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) has a short entry for 'Uthman ibn 'Abdullah ibn al-Arqam al-Qurashi, who narrated from his grandfather; 'Attaf ibn Khalid al-Madani narrated from him.
research_evidence: عثمان بْن عَبْد اللَّه بْن الأرقم الْقُرَشِيّ عَنْ جده، روى عَنْهُ عطاف بْن خَالِد، الْمَدَنِيّ
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن عبد الله بن أبي
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن عبد الرحمن بن أبان
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) and Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) identify him as 'Uthman ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Aban ibn 'Uthman ibn 'Affan al-Qurashi al-Umawi of Medina; he narrated from his grandfather Aban ibn 'Uthman and Ibn Abi al-Zinad narrated from him. Ibn Abi Hatim records Abu Hatim calling him weak in hadith, also quoted by Ibn al-Jawzi (al-Du'afa' wa al-Matrukun).
research_evidence: عثمان بْن عَبْد الرَّحْمَن بن ابان بن عثمان القرشى الاموى عَنْ أبان، روى عَنْهُ ابْن أَبِي الزناد، الْمَدَنِيّ
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن عبد الرحمن بن سعيد
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) identifies him as 'Uthman ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'id ibn Yarbu' al-Qurashi al-Makhzumi, a Hijazi. He heard from 'Urwa and his son Abu Bakr narrated from him.
research_evidence: عثمان بْن عَبْد الرَّحْمَن بْن سَعِيد بْن يربوع الْقُرَشِيّ مخزومي، سَمِعَ عُرْوَة، روى عَنْهُ ابنه أَبُو بكر، حجازي
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن مضرس بن عثمان الجهني
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir), Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) identify him as 'Uthman ibn Mudarris ibn 'Uthman al-Juhani, brother of 'Umar ibn Mudarris. He narrated from his father and Harmala ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz narrated from him.
research_evidence: عُثْمَان بْن مُضرس بْن عُثْمَان الْجُهَنِيّ أَخُو عمر بْن مُضرس يروي عَنْ أَبِيه رَوَى عَنْهُ حَرْمَلَة
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عثمان بن مرجعة أبو مرجعة الهنائي
bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says 'Uthman ibn Marja'a, Abu Marja'a al-Huna'i, was from Basra and narrated from 'Ikrima and Malik ibn Dinar. Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) says he heard 'Ikrima's own saying and narrated from Malik ibn Dinar.
research_evidence: عُثْمَان بْن مرجعة أَبُو مرجعة الْهنائِي من أهل الْبَصْرَة يروي عَنْ عِكْرِمَة وَمَالك بْن دِينَار
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: علي بن عبد الله بن رفاعة
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) says 'Ali ibn 'Abdullah ibn Rifa'a narrated from Rabi' ibn Ma'bad, as reported by al-Layth from Yahya ibn Sa'id; 'Abd al-Wahhab instead reported it from Yahya as 'Abdullah ibn 'Ali ibn Rifa'a al-Qurazi. His hadith is among the people of Medina.
research_evidence: عَلِيّ بْن عَبْد اللَّه بْن رفاعة عَنْ ربيع بْن معبد - قَالَه اللَّيْثُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْن سَعِيد
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: علي بن يزيد بن أبي حكيمة
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir), Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) say he heard from Iyas ibn Salama (from his father) and also narrated from his own father. Al-Humaydi and Dhu'ayb ibn 'Imama al-Sahmi narrated from him; Ibn Hibban lists him among reliable narrators.
research_evidence: على بن يزيد بن ابى حكيمة سمع إياس بن سلمة روى عنه ذؤيب بن عمامة السهمى والحميدي
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: علي بن مسلم بن خباب مولى
bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat), al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) and Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) identify him as a mawla of Banu Layth, Abu al-Hasan, brother of Muhammad ibn Muslim ibn Khabbab. He narrated from Sa'id al-Maqburi, and Ibn Hibban says the Iraqis narrated from him.
research_evidence: عَليّ بْن مُسلم بْن خباب مولى بني لَيْث أَخُو مُحَمَّد بْن مُسلم بْن خباب كنيته أَبُو الْحسن يروي عَن سعيد المَقْبُري
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: علي بن نافع مولى بني نمير
bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says 'Ali ibn Nafi', mawla of Banu Numayr, was from Basra and narrated mursal and maqtu' reports, with Ayyub narrating from him. Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) names Ayyub and Sakhr ibn Juwayriya al-Basri as narrating from him.
research_evidence: عَليّ بْن نَافِع مولى بني نمير من أهل الْبَصْرَة يروي الْمَرَاسِيل والمقاطيع روى عَنْهُ أَيُّوب
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: علي بن عبيد الله أبو عاصم
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) and Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) identify him as 'Ali ibn 'Ubaydullah, Abu 'Asim al-Ghatafani, from Kufa. He heard from Yasar ibn Numayr and Thabit ibn 'Ubayd; al-Thawri and Abu 'Awana narrated from him.
research_evidence: عَليّ بْن عبيد اللَّه أَبُو عَاصِم الْغَطَفَانِي من أهل الْكُوفَة يروي عَن ثَابت بْن عبيد ويسار بْن نمير
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمرو بن غيلان الثقفي أمير البصرة
bio: Ibn Manzur (Mukhtasar Tarikh Dimashq) names him 'Amr ibn Ghaylan ibn Salama al-Thaqafi (also called 'Amr ibn 'Abdullah ibn Ghaylan), says it is claimed he had companionship, that he narrated one hadith from the Prophet and narrated from 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, and quotes Khalifa that he governed Basra and lived in Ta'if. Ibn 'Abd al-Barr (al-Isti'ab) says his hadith among the Syrians is not strong, his kunya was Abu 'Abdullah, and his father Ghaylan ibn Salama was a companion.
research_evidence: عمرو بن غيلان بن سلمة ويقال: عمرو بن عبد الله بن غيلان، الثّقفيّ قيل: إن له صحبة
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمرو بن عامر بن عبد الله
bio: Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) has a short entry for 'Amr ibn 'Amir ibn 'Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, who narrated from his father, from Ibn 'Abbad ibn Rabi'a.
research_evidence: عَمْرو بْن عَامِرِ بْن عَبْد اللَّه بْن الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْن عباد بْن ربيعة
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمرو بن عتبة بن أبي لهب
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) record him saying he came to Umm Hani' when the people of the Camel were defeated; Ibn Abi Hatim says he narrated from his father and Ma'ruf narrated from him. Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says he narrated from the Hijazis and his son Muhammad narrated from him.
research_evidence: عمرو بن عتبة بن أبي لهب الهاشمي قال أتيت ام هانئ حين هزم اصحاب الجمل، روى عن أبيه روى عنه معروف
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat), Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) and al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) identify him as 'Isa ibn al-Fadl ibn Ma'qil ibn Sinan al-Ashja'i. He heard from 'Abdullah ibn Niyar al-Aslami (from his maternal uncle 'Amr ibn Shas), and Aban ibn Salih narrated from him.
research_evidence: عِيسَى بْن الْفضل بْن معقل بْن سِنَان الْأَشْجَعِيّ يروي عَنْ عَبْد اللَّه بْن نيار الْأَسْلَمِيّ روى عَنْهُ أبان بْن صَالح
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) identifies him as 'Isa ibn 'Awn ibn Hafs ibn al-Furafisa al-Hanafi, narrating from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari, with the Iraqis narrating from him. Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) says he narrated mursal reports from Yahya ibn Sa'id and Abu Bakr ibn Hazm.
research_evidence: عِيسَى بْن عون بْن حَفْص بْن الفرافصة الْحَنَفِيّ يروي عَنْ يَحْيَى بن سعيد الْأنْصَارِيّ روى عَنهُ الْعِرَاقِيُّونَ
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) and al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) identify him as 'Imran ibn 'Uthman ibn al-Arqam ibn Abi al-Arqam al-Qurashi. He narrated from his father, and his son Yahya ibn 'Imran narrated from him.
research_evidence: عمرَان بْن عُثْمَان بْن الأرقم بْن أبي الأرقم الْقرشِي يروي عَن أَبِيه روى عَنهُ ابْنه يَحْيَى بْن عمرَان
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عامر بن عبد الله بن نسطاس
bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) says 'Amir ibn 'Abdullah ibn Nistas was from Medina and narrated from the Hijazis. Al-Bukhari (al-Tarikh al-Kabir) and Ibn Abi Hatim (al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil) name 'Abdullah ibn Yazid ibn Hurmuz as narrating from him.
research_evidence: عَامر بْن عَبْد اللَّهِ بْن نسطاس من أهل الْمَدِينَة يروي عَن الْحِجَازِيِّينَ روى عَنهُ عَبْد الله
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عاصم بن عمرو بن أبي أحمد
bio: Ibn Hibban (al-Thiqat) identifies him as 'Asim ibn 'Amr ibn Abi Ahmad ibn Jahsh al-Qurashi. He narrated from the Hijazis, and Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj narrated from him.
research_evidence: عَاصِم بن عَمْرو بن أبي أَحْمد بْن جحش الْقرشِي يروي عَن الْحِجَازِيِّينَ روى عَنْهُ بكير بْن الْأَشَج
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil says Asim, client (mawla) of Quraiba, Abu Bakr, father of Ali ibn Asim al-Wasiti, narrated from Urwa ibn al-Zubayr and Quraiba, and that Shu'ba and Hushaym narrated from him. Abu Hatim graded him 'salih'. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir names the patron as Quraiba bint Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr.
research_evidence: عاصم مولى قريبة أبو بكر والد على بن عاصم الواسطي روى عن عروة بن الزبير وقريبة روى عنه شعبة وهشيم
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمارة بن عبد الرحمن أبو عبد
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil lists Umara ibn Abd al-Rahman Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Iskandarani, narrating from Ikrima, with Ibn al-Mubarak narrating from him. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir gives his kunya as Abu Abd Allah and says he heard Ikrima's own sayings and Ibn al-Mubarak heard from him.
research_evidence: عمارة بن عبد الرحمن أبو عبد الرحمن الاسكندرانى عكرمة روى عنه ابن المبارك
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمارة بن أبي شعيب القسملي البصري
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil, Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat and al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir all say Umara ibn Abi Shu'ayb al-Qasmali of Basra narrated from Malik ibn Dinar, and that Muslim and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna heard from him. Ibn Hibban lists him among trustworthy narrators.
research_evidence: عمارة بن ابى شعيب القسملى البصري روى عن مالك بن دينار سمع منه مسلم ومحمد بن المثنى
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عتبة بن إبراهيم بن أبي خداش
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil says Utba ibn Ibrahim ibn Abi Khidash al-Lahabi was a Meccan who narrated a mursal hadith, and that Ibn Uyayna narrated from him. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir quotes Ali (ibn al-Madini) calling his report mursal.
research_evidence: عتبة بن ابراهيم بن ابى خداش اللهبى مكى روى حديثا مرسلا روى عنه ابن عيينة
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عباس بن عبد الله بن عثمان
bio: Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir says Abbas ibn Abd Allah ibn Uthman ibn Humayd, of Banu Asad ibn Abd al-Uzza of Quraysh, a Meccan, narrated from Amr ibn Dinar, and that Abu Asim and Ibn Jurayj heard from him. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists him likewise, with Abu Asim al-Nabil narrating from him.
research_evidence: عَبَّاس بْن عَبْد اللَّه بْن عثمان بْن حميد من بَنِي أسد بْن عَبْد العزى الْقُرَشِيّ الْمَكِّيّ عَنْ عَمْرو بْن دينار
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عون بن الخطاب بن عبد الله
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil says Awn ibn al-Khattab ibn Abd Allah ibn Rafi' narrated from a son of Anas ibn Malik, and that Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated from him. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir cites his report via Ibn Abi Dhi'b of the hadith that the houris in Paradise sing; Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists him.
research_teachers: a son of Anas ibn Malik
research_evidence: عون بن الخطاب بن عبد الله بن رافع عن ابن لانس بن مالك روى عنه ابن أبي ذئب
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عون مولى أم حكيم بنت يحيى
bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil says Awn was the client of Umm Hakim daughter of Yahya ibn al-Hakam, of Medina; Umm Hakim was the wife of the caliph Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik. He narrated from al-Zuhri, and al-Majishun, Ibn Abi Dhi'b and his son Muhammad ibn Awn narrated from him. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat also lists him.
research_students: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salama al-Majishun
research_evidence: عون مولى ام حكيم ابنة يحيى بن الحكم المدينى، وام حكيم امرأة هشام بن عبد الملك روى عن الزهري
dod_s: c. 796 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

bio: Ibn Abi Hatim's al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil says Awn ibn al-Ashhab ibn Milqam ibn al-Tilibb ibn Tha'laba al-Anbari al-Tamimi narrated from his ancestor al-Tilibb, and that Musa ibn Isma'il narrated from him. Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat says he narrated from Milqam ibn al-Tilibb, that al-Tilibb is said to have been a Companion, and that Basrans narrated from him.
research_evidence: عون بن الاشهب بن ملقام بن التلب بن ثعلبة العنبري التميمي روى عن جده التلب روى عنه موسى بن اسمعيل
